title: Every calorie has to fight for its life.

segments.text: okay tell us about what you eat every day yeah so I I have 2 000 calories every day it's a 20 caloric restrictions every calorie has to fight for its life there's nothing in there that's nice to have there's nothing that's trendy or cool or something it's an absolute necessity and then we have we can measure every single thing going into the body we can see it's input in and put out so we should see the efficacy so I have two meals that are the same every day and then one meal that varies I can't even tell you how much I love my food
